name: East Asian Languages and Cultures, PhD

groups.label: Courses in the major field defined by culture and discipline (500-level)
Elective 500-level courses
groups.note: Two graduate courses in a second discipline and two in a second culture must be completed as part of the Ph.D. coursework

groups.label: Language Requirement:

courses.title: Thesis Research (32 max applied toward degree)

groups.note: Candidates must demonstrate a knowledge of one East Asian language at the fourth-year level by satisfactory completion of appropriate (400-level) coursework or examination and passage of a written examination covering material studied while in residence. Demonstration of proficiency in a second language relevant to the student's course of study usually Chinese, Japanese, Korean evidenced by either a) completion of minimum of two years of an approved sequence courses; or b) by examination.
